svg.aria-label: STEMI. Schematic heart with a blocked left anterior descending artery and an ECG beat with ST elevation. Primary PCI within 90 minutes of first medical contact, or within 120 minutes if transfer is needed; otherwise fibrinolytics if symptoms began under 12 hours ago.
